fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami’s enforcement of “blue laws” affecting tourist entertainment (closures and restrictions on dancing and venues), criticism of professional receiverships and civic opportunism, and notes on traffic/parking and public safety. Reports and opinion pieces address inadequate public transportation and racial segregation on streetcars/buses, local Chamber of Commerce turmoil, and real estate conditions. Features include humor/poetry columns, a satirical piece involving “Rye K. Hammerhead Greeby,” coverage of the Florida Overseas Highway opening and its significance for Coral Gables and regional growth, and letters to the editor (including complaints about a cat show judging). Advertisements and local notices appear throughout.
